Name: Seasonal Silo Reskin - smaller cuter silo - Content Patcher (CP) or Alternative Textures (AT)
Author: UraniumRatt
Description:
A very simple reskin of the ugly silo. Just a tent with haystacks.

If you want to make a recolor of those feel free! But please warn me so I can recommend it here in the description or if you wish, add to the files. (and check it out :[])

Downloads.Description:
Fixed the roof, it's more symmetrical and cuter now.

Added foliage, mushrooms and flowers for the seasonal ver.
Fixed manifest showing the wrong version.
